sources.intended_use: Territory/city navigation and administrative context; never a language boundary.
limitations: The layer mixes territories and cities, so ADM2 features cannot all be labelled as territories.
The represented boundary year is 2019 and requires renewed administrative review before public release.
Names, hierarchy, identifiers, and topology still require independent review against authoritative DRC records.
